predecessors.name: Azerbaijan Democratic Republic
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's Azerbaijan Democratic Republic of 1919 (72,209 km2)

ledger.x: 1920, 28 April: "The Azerbaijan SSR was established on 28 April 1920 after the surrender of the government of the" Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.

1921, 13 October: the Treaty of Kars (Article V) "established the region of Nakhchivan as an autonomous territory under the protection of Azerbaijan", made up of the former Nakhichevan uezd, the Sharur section and southern parts of the Erivan uezd (Azerbaijan page: the "previously independent Nakhcivan SSR would also…
1922, 12 March: "On 12 March 1922 the leaders of Azerbaijan, Armenian, and Georgian Soviet Socialist Republics established a union".
1936, December: "In December 1936, the Transcaucasian Union was dismantled" and the Azerbaijan SSR becomes a union republic.
1991, 5 February: "Azerbaijan SSR was renamed the Republic of Azerbaijan" (sovereignty declared 23 September 1989).
1991, 18 October: "Azerbaijan adopted its declaration of independence on 18 October 1991."

certainty.note: Nakhchivan's status before the Treaty of Kars and the Karabakh and Zangezur lines are not on the pages opened.
Kars border with Turkey and the Soviet-Persian line; internal Armenian and Georgian lines are the modern ones.
